source.original_feedback_text:
Part 1 Feedback: In your ontology, you create a thoughtful, top-down design that is articulated and supported by a six-property hierarchy, including inverse functional and symmetric declarations, which are applied appropriately. The axiom defining the open, toasted and double decker variants uses number restrictions and is traceable to cited text, showing good alignment. The narrative is concise yet comprehensive. You could consider adding a brief reflection on scalability trade-offs and also evaluating whether Wikipedia is a reliable source.

Part 2 Feedback: Your modal logic tasks are well-structured, and the formulas are correct, concise, and effectively utilise the provided spatial relations and operators to model the sandwich constraints for each task. Your comments are clear and demonstrate not only technical accuracy but also an excellent understanding of the real-world and cultural context behind the rules, drawing on specific Wikipedia references and plausible food examples.
